name: gore
description: Mod Gothic 1 Remake with the GORE toolkit: textures, localized text, dialog, audio, voice-over, item values and AngelScript, built into one bundle and deployed as a unit.

interface.shortDescription: Mod Gothic 1 Remake — textures, text, audio, voice and scripts in one bundle
interface.longDescription: Guides an agent through modding Gothic 1 Remake with the gore CLI: choosing a target the engine actually reads, relaying the consent gate that guards the installation, and saying afterwards what a deploy did and did not prove. The facts live in the guide shipped inside gore.exe, so they never drift from the version you are running. Needs the gore CLI installed and on PATH, plus one command to register the server, because a Codex plugin carries skills and not MCP servers: codex mcp add gore -- gore mcp serve
defaultPrompt: Build me a test mod for Gothic 1 Remake so I can see modding works.
Change some menu text in Gothic 1 Remake and tell me how to undo it.
